expectations.text: Uses cub unit apply (the apply verb), not kubectl apply or argocd app sync
expectations.evidence: All three apply calls are `cub unit apply …`.
`cub unit apply hello-ns --wait --timeout 2m0s` and same for hello-app.

expectations.text: Does NOT pass --change-desc on cub unit apply
expectations.evidence: Write-up explicitly: 'No --change-desc — cub unit apply is a runtime operation, not a config-data mutation.'

expectations.text: Runs a --dry-run on a non-trivial apply before the real one
expectations.evidence: `cub unit apply hello-app --dry-run` shown before the real apply.

expectations.text: Preflights ApplyGates with a LEN(ApplyGates) > 0 check (or cub unit list with the gates filter)
expectations.evidence: `cub unit list --where "Slug IN (…) AND LEN(ApplyGates) > 0"` returning none.
`cub worker status eval-worker --space skill-examples` returning Ready.

expectations.text: On apply failure, does NOT retry blindly — collects bridgestate/worker logs and hands off
expectations.evidence: Failure path references `cub unit bridgestate` + `cub worker logs` and routes to verify-delivery instead of retrying.

expectations.text: Hands off to verify-delivery after apply, both for success and failure cases
expectations.evidence: 'Hand-off' section explicitly routes both units to verify-delivery.
